name: Ciena Corporation
blurb: Ciena Corporation is a networking systems, services, and software company specializing in optical transport, packet networking, and broadband access. It provides solutions for communications service providers, cloud providers, and enterprises to build high-capacity networks. Ciena is a leading player in optical networking, benefiting from AI-driven cloud demand for its WaveLogic coherent optics.
recent: In recent weeks, Ciena's stock rose 5.7% after reporting surging demand from cloud providers for AI-focused optical networking products and a large AI-related order backlog. However, insider share sales of about US$23.6 million and valuation concerns have tempered investor enthusiasm.
